_comment: Content served in English on a language site, by decision (Jan, 2026-11-12: mirror IBM's addon docs, English only for now). `docs`: path prefixes under docs/ that translation/v2 (extract, update, bootstrap, render) and translation-status.py skip, so no PO exists and the locale builds the English page. `sidebarPrefixes`: sidebar ids whose labels scripts/check-sidebar-translations.js does not require in i18n/*/docusaurus-plugin-content-docs/current.json. `translatedIn`: locales that DO translate these pages and sidebars (Jan, 2026-11-13: translate the addons locale by locale); the POTs exist as soon as one locale is listed. To bring in a locale: add it here, run sync.py prepare --locales <it>, add its sidebar keys, fill, finish.
